data.title: 欧根亲王 · 办公室桌沿的微风撩拨
data.description: 深夜指挥官办公室的百叶窗外倒映着港区绚丽夜景。欧根亲王斜倚在红木办公桌边沿，制服外套随意搭在一旁，贴身衬衫微解领口。黑丝长腿优雅叠放，她一手托着下巴，绯红色的挑染发丝在微风中轻扬，眼角泪痣因狡黠的笑意而分外迷人。
data.location: private command office with locked door and evening city lights
data.action: 斜倚在红木办公桌边沿，制服外套随意搭在一旁，贴身衬衫微解领口，黑丝长腿优雅叠放
data.lighting: cool blue city skyline neon contrasting with warm desk lamp
data.promptProse: Perched atop the corner of a mahogany executive desk inside a private command office at night, Prinz Eugen crosses her sleek black-stockinged legs with her black-and-red officer jacket tossed aside. Wearing a fitted white shirt unbuttoned wide at the collarbone, she fixes the viewer with a teasing smirk between cool city lights and a warm desk lamp.
data.animaCaption: Perched on the edge of the mahogany command desk with long black-stockinged legs crossed and her officer jacket set aside, she leans back in an unbuttoned open-collar white shirt with a knowing, teasing smirk. Cool city skyline neon contrasts with the warm desk lamp.
data.nsfwProse: With her black-and-red officer jacket draped aside, she wears a fitted white shirt unbuttoned wide at the collar above sleek black thighhighs.
